plus the raw bytes of the fixture members named in the output - nothing decoded, nothing written).

Coordinator brief 2026-09-23 item 1: record archive / member identities, duplicate / override candidates, jersey / pants and every
required sock component, missing / unknown evidence, spare candidates and exact residuals; do not equate file names with payload

the join (complete / incomplete with the missing components named); spares (complete candidates vs incomplete leftovers); members that

(first stock row + one spare) with member identities and SHA-256 of the stored bytes.
Usage: python r76_ps3_archive_kit_join.py <out.json> [--titles ps3-nhl12,ps3-nhl13]
